material_type: Urine is considered an ideal proximal fluid for the study of EV in urological cancers due to its direct contact with the urogenital system.
sex: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.

sample_source.evidence: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).
